f.title: Submit the DSMB list and charter with the clinical trial application
f.statement: The clinical trial application form should be accompanied by, among other documents, the list and charter of the Data Safety Monitoring Board (DSMB).
f.clause: 2.5 Clinical Trial Application (2.5.16 List and Charter of the Data Safety Monitoring Board)
f.applicability: Clinical trials (including BA/BE studies) authorised by NAFDAC in Nigeria (DER-GDL-002-03)

f.title: Notify NAFDAC of SAEs within seven calendar days of receipt
f.statement: The Agency shall be notified of any serious adverse events (SAEs) within seven calendar days from the date of receipt of the information.
f.applicability: Clinical trials (including BA/BE studies) authorised by NAFDAC in Nigeria (DER-GDL-002-03)
